hook.evidence: Motivates integration of 5G and TSN to meet deterministic requirements for emerging applications.

gap.evidence: Notes limited surveys covering standards, integration frameworks, research developments, applications, and challenges together.

yes_but.evidence: Acknowledges existing works but highlights missing comprehensive 5G-TSN integration view.

contribution.evidence: Lists contributions including background, integration frameworks, state-of-art research, application domains, and challenges.

scope_boundary.evidence: Scope includes TSN/5G background, integration frameworks, research developments, applications, and challenges.

rhetorical_moves_global.reader_contract_pattern: Motivate 5G-TSN integration; review background; present integration frameworks; survey research; cover applications; list challenges; conclude.

branches: Applications: industrial automation, ITS, smart energy, digital health

visuals_tables.layout_logic: Figures/tables used for standards/architectures and integration frameworks; research/applications include illustrative tables and comparison figures; challenges are text-heavy.

tables.purpose: summarize standards, frameworks, or application requirements

lesson_blocks.lesson: 3GPP frameworks and programmable architectures set determinants for TSN integration.
State-of-art clusters around frameworks/performance, synchronization, and QoS configuration.
Domain-specific requirements (industry, ITS, energy, health) guide integration strategies.
Open issues center on synchronization under mobility, cross-layer QoS mapping, and reliability under variability.

synthesis.aha_moment: Maintaining a platform- and domain-aware sequence--from standards through integration, research themes, applications, and challenges--keeps 5G-TSN design trade-offs traceable.

style.section_openers_pattern: Introduce standards/frameworks/research topics, then enumerate subareas with figures/tables and close with insights/outlook.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Intro with contributions and survey comparison
steps: Compare with existing surveys to expose the gap.
List contributions and scope; provide organization roadmap.

steps: Use a table/figure to summarize both, setting up integration.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Gives readers aligned baselines for both technologies before integration frameworks.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Integration -> research themes -> applications
steps: Map to application domains and synthesize requirements/strategies.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Keeps flow from standards to research to domain requirements coherent.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Challenge buckets with future directions
steps: Group challenges into synchronization, QoS mapping, and reliability under variability.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Organized challenge buckets make the research agenda actionable.
